system: Adversarial senior engineer. Only provided context, no tools, no repository inspection, no source edits. This is last targeted design review: identify material technical flaws, no superficial nitpicks, no assurances of bug-free implementation.
prompt: FINAL NARROW ANTITHESIS: evaluate this revised v4 plan for durable publication, Allen queue ACK semantics, Git race ID stability and typed healthy silence. Prior reviews yielded 5 original blockers, then four critical/high, then four residual high. Do any high/critical structural blockers remain in the described system? Give exact trace, minimal spec correction, required adversarial test. Confirm whether H1–H4 now have deterministic falsification tests. Note any inconsistency with real Cloudflare API (provided) and recovery after full-feed stale-200/queue-capacity outage. End with a crisp reasoned verdict: plan ready for offline implementation/test, or missing blocker(s), with severity. Do not claim it's actually bug-free or tested. Max 1200 words.
context: Canonical synthesis v4 on branch research/conversation-sequence-evidence-20261024 at docs/research/room-human-conversation-implementation-plan-20261024.md. User wants natural human interaction mechanisms, not repeated-word suppression. Live Room unchanged; draft PR #313 not merged.

Worker source directly inspected: room-live-mirroro/src/index.js: POST /api/allen queues an item with crypto.randomUUID, 202 accepted, viewer displays 'Allen is queued for the next Room beat'; GET /api/participant/pending returns up to 20 items; POST /api/participant/ack internally deletes matching queue IDs (not user-visible); POST /api/ingest stores latest feed in Durable Object, returns accepted:true on 202 or accepted:false older/stale on 200; GET /api/feed supplies UI. Existing workflow publish_relay() swallows failures and ack_allen_turns() is called regardless after successful git push, a bug.

room_participant.py injects Allen turn into local conversation/discourse and observers BEFORE expression nodes; message ID deterministic from queue ID; writes these local JSON files and an ack-ids file. Even when autonomous expressions fail, accepted Allen input should be durably published. Workflow commits room files then pushes, then relay and ACK.

v4 A: typed beat outcomes: chosen_silence only if observation/floor stages successfully completed without scheduling an expression, unhealthy: model_unavailable, invalid generation, bad config, infra failure. One Room orchestration writer; last_healthy_beat_at vs last_public_event_at; sliding failure ratio independent of healthy silence; 300s coalesced health persists before 900s watchdog; sustained legitimate silence triggers diagnostic only not forced speech; accepted Allen input commits immediately even with no autonomous speech.

v4 B: Git main authoritative, Cloudflare mirror user-visible. Stable decision ID from digest of relevant prior durable Room conversational state + next_sequence + source input ids + selected action, not content or GITHUB_RUN_ID. Stage all exact bytes; push complete Git commit before mirror outbox eligible. If unrelated metadata commit races, reuse same ID+text; if Room relevant parent changes, local D1 is abandoned (never posted) and new decision recomputed; upstream duplicate Allen message ID no new event. Git published commit contains reconstructible relay-pending journal. Mirror /api/ingest 202 accepted OR stale 200 only verified if GET /api/feed contains required published message IDs. Retry pending. Only after verified Git durability and mirror visibility internal /api/participant/ack removes matched Allen queue IDs, with duplicate ACK safe; no nonexistent user-facing ACK API. Prolonged outage queue remains pending and may reach MAX_QUEUE; spec calls for capacity alert and recovery test. Zero speech + Allen input has a public Allen event even with no agent speech.

v4 C: experimental control and shadow isolated in state, writable trees, endpoints and model/caches/quotas or counterbalanced sequential runs. No production credentials in replay. Shadow ON/OFF production deterministically equal; resource impact checked.

v4 gates: kill/retry before git, after git before ingest, after ingest before queue deletion, after delete; forced push race with metadata vs conversation changes, stale-feed 200, relay 500, queue full, 900s chosen silence, mixed 90% failure/10% healthy; maintain no duplicates and no lost Allen item; no forced novel words, short repair allowed. Later phases blinded human annotated action-level tests.
expected_response: Strict independent design verdict, remaining blockers if any, exact tests, no implementation work.
